mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 16 degrees now, scattered clouds. Next 24 hours: high 16, low 10.

Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti appointed Fëllanza Podrimja as deputy minister of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora.

The United States has approved the possible sale of two M142 HIMARS rocket artillery systems to Albania, enhancing its long-range strike capability.

Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz warned that Israel could expand its operations into Gaza, Lebanon and Syria if tensions further escalate.

Approximately 300,000 children living abroad of German residents are now receiving the German child benefit (Kindergeld), with about 39% of them being children of Polish citizens.

Spanish coach Pep Guardiola is again being linked to Saudi Arabian clubs as they enter negotiations to hire him.
